claim: Every link decision is made blind: GSC does not expose the Links report. The $70/yr Permaculture Australia listing stays declined on the other three grounds, no longer on price.

body.visibility: NONE. GSC's API does not expose the Links report and we have no backlink tool. Every link decision (DAL-165, DAL-232, DAL-167, DAL-252) is made blind. DAL-253 proposes Bing Webmaster Tools, which is free and does expose referring domains.
body.paid_directory_decision: DEC-245: Permaculture Australia directory declined. It is $70/yr (not $75) on the Professional tier; the $45 Ordinary tier includes no listing. The link itself is real (three listings checked, no rel attribute, indexed), but it is rented (gone on lapse), the tier is for people 'earning money from Permaculture' and treestock earns $0, and we cannot measure the result. Do not re-propose before DAL-245 is answered.
body.sequencing_rule: Decide what traffic is worth before buying traffic. The rule stands; the price does not. DEC-248 corrected the click value from 1.7-5c to 17-50c on DEC-241's own inputs (a 10x arithmetic error), with a mid case of 6.8c. DEC-245's decision to decline the $70/yr Permaculture Australia listing still holds on the other three grounds (rented link, eligibility wording, no way to observe the result), but it no longer holds on price: at 6.8c a click, 200 extra clicks a month would repay $70/yr about 2x. Do not re-open it until DAL-245 is answered and Primal Fruits has produced a measured conversion rate.

body.rfcwa_correction: DAL-165's April advice to ask the RFCWA webmaster for a links-page listing is wrong: rarefruitclub.au has no links or resources page. The realistic ask is a newsletter or meeting mention, which is audience not a link.
